name: print-social-reeded-glass-blurred-eye-cover-with-light-caps
title: Reeded-glass blurred close-up of an eye with thin white caps and an asterisk
whatItIs: A portrait photo of an eye seen through vertical ribbed glass and heavy grain in violet, brown and teal, with a giant thin white 'ЗНАЙТИ' plus an asterisk at the top left, small 'методи' below and 'і практики СЕБЕ' at the lower right.
whatItMeans: Introspective and dreamy; blur suggests self-searching.
techniques: Distort a photo with reeded-glass streaks.
Set thin caps at opposite corners.

vocabulary.definition: Vertical ribbed distortion of an image.
